opennyai_summary.PREAMBLE:
Nuthalapati Nageswara Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on
9 August, 2019
 Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.4799 of 2019
Order:
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against them in FIR No.178 of 2019 on the file of Tenali II Town Police Station, Guntur District.
The offences alleged are under Sections 420, 272, 273, 188, 328 IPC and Sections 57(i), 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.
In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in FIR No.178 of 2019 on the file of Tenali II Town Police Station, Guntur District, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
